yab = sample(2:9,3)

b = yab[3]

Question
========

Let function $f$ be defined by the algebraic expression below:

$$f(x)=\frac{x}{`r a`}-`r b`$$

Evaluate $f(`r x`)$.


Solution
========


$$f(`r x`)=\frac{`r x`}{`r a`}-`r b`$$


$$f(`r x`)=`r round(x/a)`-`r b`$$

$$f(`r x`)=`r y`$$
